mission_instrument: Mars Science Laboratory (Curiosity rover) Radiation Assessment Detector, surface, as served by NASA OSDR RadLab (instrument_id MSL-RAD-Surface)
cadence: About 1,025 s between most rows; some 548 s intervals

units.timestamp: ISO 8601 without zone suffix; the API documentation gives no time zone and does not say whether times are Mars event time or Earth receive time
units.absorbed_dose_rate: uGy/h (RadLab API documentation: absorbed dose rate in microgray per hour)
units.dose_equivalent_rate: uSv/h per the API documentation; empty in every row of this file

preprocessing: None; the CSV response saved as returned.
license_terms: NASA open data; the RadLab page links site Terms and Conditions that were not read. No license statement on the API documentation page.
provenance: REPLAY. Recorded instrument data from the Mars surface, September 2017.
is_not: Not a person's dose, not inside a habitat, not shielded like a habitat. Absorbed dose rate of one detector on a rover.

consumers.use: Radiation feed replay for the mars_surface environment and the radiation watch and act rules
Eval scenario: solar event during a Mars surface walk
